notes: This specification targets the paper's primary annual ASSETG characteristic-sort portfolio: total-assets growth, annual June formation, decile sorting, and a low-minus-high extreme-decile spread. The paper also reports equal-weighted, size-conditioned, regression, robustness, and decomposition analyses, which are not merged into this one executable target.
